application_sessions_claimed.name: application_sessions_claimed
application_sessions_claimed.value: status NOT IN ('claimed', 'completed') OR claimed_at IS NOT NULL

application_sessions_pairing.name: application_sessions_pairing
application_sessions_pairing.value: claimed_by_pairing_id IS NULL OR claimed_at IS NOT NULL

extension_pairings_used.name: extension_pairings_used
extension_pairings_used.value: last_used_at IS NULL OR claimed_at IS NOT NULL

generated.as: setweight(to_tsvector('english', title), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('english', company), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('english', description), 'C')

jobs_pay_period.name: jobs_pay_period
jobs_pay_period.value: pay_period IS NULL OR pay_period IN ('hour', 'day', 'week', 'month', 'year')

jobs_seniority.name: jobs_seniority
jobs_seniority.value: seniority IS NULL OR seniority IN ('intern', 'junior', 'mid', 'senior', 'lead', 'staff', 'principal', 'manager')

jobs_pay_currency.name: jobs_pay_currency
jobs_pay_currency.value: pay_min IS NULL OR pay_currency IS NOT NULL

jobs_pay_range.name: jobs_pay_range
jobs_pay_range.value: pay_min IS NULL OR pay_max IS NULL OR pay_max >= pay_min

jobs_eligibility_phrase.name: jobs_eligibility_phrase
jobs_eligibility_phrase.value: eligibility_phrase IS NOT NULL OR eligibility = 'unclear'

opportunities_status.name: opportunities_status
opportunities_status.value: status IS NULL OR status IN ('saved', 'applied', 'interviewing', 'offer', 'closed')

opportunities_outcome.name: opportunities_outcome
opportunities_outcome.value: outcome IS NULL OR outcome IN ('accepted', 'rejected', 'no_response', 'withdrawn')

opportunities_dismiss_reason.name: opportunities_dismiss_reason
opportunities_dismiss_reason.value: dismiss_reason IS NULL OR dismiss_reason IN ('wrong_stack', 'too_senior', 'pay', 'location', 'other')

opportunities_rate_type.name: opportunities_rate_type
opportunities_rate_type.value: rate_type IS NULL OR rate_type IN ('hourly', 'fixed')

opportunities_touched.name: opportunities_touched
opportunities_touched.value: status IS NOT NULL OR dismissed_at IS NOT NULL

opportunities_board_not_dismissed.name: opportunities_board_not_dismissed
opportunities_board_not_dismissed.value: status IS NULL OR dismissed_at IS NULL

opportunities_dismiss_reason_needs_dismi.name: opportunities_dismiss_reason_needs_dismissal
opportunities_dismiss_reason_needs_dismi.value: dismiss_reason IS NULL OR dismissed_at IS NOT NULL

opportunities_contract_fields.name: opportunities_contract_fields
opportunities_contract_fields.value: type = 'contract' OR (rate_amount IS NULL AND rate_type IS NULL AND rate_currency IS NULL AND platform IS NULL)

outputs_must_answer_value.name: outputs_must_answer_value
outputs_must_answer_value.value: must_answer IS NULL OR must_answer IN ('salary', 'work_auth', 'notice', 'start_date', 'references')

outputs_must_answer_not_generated.name: outputs_must_answer_not_generated
outputs_must_answer_not_generated.value: must_answer IS NULL OR (ai_call_id IS NULL AND generated_at IS NULL)

sources_last_status.name: sources_last_status
sources_last_status.value: last_status IS NULL OR last_status IN ('ok', 'failed', 'rate_limited', 'suspicious_empty', 'skipped')

users_seniority.name: users_seniority
users_seniority.value: seniority IS NULL OR seniority IN ('junior', 'mid', 'senior', 'lead', 'staff', 'principal')

users_ai_provider.name: users_ai_provider
users_ai_provider.value: ai_provider IS NULL OR ai_provider IN ('anthropic', 'openai')
